claims.head: Where the Canadiens have the edge: shot quality
claims.body: The Canadiens are around the middle of the league for shot quality, and the Jets are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

WPG.head: Too close to call
WPG.body: Even though Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, Montréal has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. For the Jets, the difference could be a penalty kill that holds up.

MTL.head: Too close to call
MTL.body: Even though Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, Montréal has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canadiens can tip it if they keep the shots coming.

story.head: The Jets need a win
paras: The Jets are winless in four (0-2-2). The Canadiens are 5-3-2.

items.text: Nino Niederreiter is one point from 500.
The Canadiens are newly without Nick Suzuki, and have been without Samuel Montembeault and Ivan Demidov for several games. Jacob Fowler is expected to start.
The Jets have been without Josh Morrissey since Oct 7.
Kyle Connor has scored in four straight games against Montréal.
